html:
Brimstone Hill Fortress on St Kitts is a hilltop fort built by the British over about a century from 1690, mostly by enslaved Africans. It was called the Gibraltar of the West Indies.

In 1782 a French army besieged it for a month in the American War of Independence, and the garrison surrendered. The Treaty of Paris gave the island back to Britain the next year.

The fort was abandoned in 1853 and restored in the 20th century. It became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999, praised as a well kept example of 17th and 18th century military building in the British Empire, and a reminder of the enslaved labour that built it.
sum: Brimstone Hill Fortress on St Kitts is a hilltop fort built by the British over about a century from 1690, mostly by enslaved Africans. It was called the Gibraltar of the West Indies.
